sensors.name: Build
sensors.description: Run the package build script (Remix + Vite).

sensors.name: Lint
sensors.description: Run ESLint across the monorepo.

sensors.name: Lint --fix
sensors.description: Run ESLint with --fix and re-stage. Use only in dedicated chore commits.

sensors.name: Format
sensors.description: Run Prettier on the workspace.

sensors.name: Typecheck
sensors.description: Run `tsc --noEmit` across the monorepo with strict mode.

sensors.name: Unit tests
sensors.description: Run Vitest across the workspace.

sensors.name: Coverage threshold
sensors.description: Fail the build if `packages/lib` coverage drops below 70% lines / 65% branches, or critical services below 90%.

sensors.name: E2E tests
sensors.description: Run Playwright in `packages/app-tests`.

sensors.name: E2E smoke
sensors.description: Run only the @smoke-tagged Playwright suites for fast feedback.

sensors.name: API contract tests
sensors.description: Run REST v1 and tRPC contract tests under `packages/app-tests/e2e/api`.

sensors.name: Axe accessibility
sensors.description: Run axe on the key signing pages in Playwright.

sensors.name: Prisma migration diff
sensors.description: Verify no uncommitted Prisma schema drift between branch and main.

sensors.name: Prisma generate
sensors.description: Regenerate Prisma client and Zod models after schema changes.

sensors.name: DB reset
sensors.description: Reset the local Postgres, push schema, and re-seed. Used in CI smoke.

sensors.name: DB seed
sensors.description: Seed fixtures from `packages/prisma/seed`.

sensors.name: Audit log emission
sensors.description: Grep tRPC procedures and services to confirm every state transition writes a `DocumentAuditLog` row.

sensors.name: i18n keys present
sensors.description: Verify every new translation key exists in every locale under `packages/lib/translations/`. Diff against the base `en` catalogue.

sensors.name: EE license gate
sensors.description: Verify every code path under `packages/ee` is guarded by `LicenseClient` checks.

sensors.name: Recipient token redaction
sensors.description: Static check that recipient tokens are never logged in full; only the first 4 chars may appear in error responses.

sensors.name: Webhook HMAC signing
sensors.description: Verify outbound webhooks include an HMAC-SHA256 header and the helper signs the body.

sensors.name: No raw HTML for user content
sensors.description: Fail if `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` is used on user-controlled content.

sensors.name: Dependency audit
sensors.description: Run `pnpm audit`; block release on high or critical advisories.

sensors.name: Docs site build
sensors.description: Build the public docs site (`apps/docs`) and the search index.

sensors.name: LLM-friendly docs
sensors.description: Regenerate `apps/docs/src/app/llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` from the MDX source.

sensors.name: Telemetry opt-in
sensors.description: Verify `TelemetryClient` calls are opt-in; flag any unconditional reporting.

sensors.name: Date format + locale
sensors.description: Verify the default locale is `pt-BR` and date rendering goes through `formatDate` (DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm).

sensors.name: Smoke routes
sensors.description: Curl key Remix routes (`/`, `/signing`, `/admin`) and assert 200/302 (auth redirect).

notes: Critical sensors block release; warning sensors block merge; info sensors are advisory.
Custom `node scripts/sensors/*.mjs` scripts live in the team's runbook; their paths are illustrative until implemented.
Add new sensors here when the team introduces a new gate (e.g. `sealing-job-slo`, `webhook-retry-budget`).
Sensors are executed in the order listed per phase; longer sensors run last to fail fast on quick checks.
